articles.title: Meta: Keep Calm And Focus On Muse Spark And Record Revenue Growth
articles.text: Meta Platforms, Inc. delivered strong Q1 results, beating on revenue and EPS, with operating margins steady at 41% despite a 35% jump in expenses. AI investments are driving tangible ROI, with key products like Lattice and GEM boosting ad conversion rates and monetization, evidenced by doubling run-rates in ad tools. Capex guidance has materially increased, with $107 billion in new contractual commitments through 2027 and a notable Q1 pause in buybacks, warranting closer investor scrutiny.

articles.text: Meta will start using AI to scan photos and videos for visual clues to see if a user is under 13 and should be removed from Facebook and Instagram, the company announced on Tuesday. These visual clues include a person's height or bone structure, it said.
